Part marks are given for correct method with minor errors, or for missing one quantity. No marks are given for missing multiple quantities or using fundamentally incorrect impedance models.
rubric.answer_key: ω = 5 rad/s. Z_R = 8 Ω. Z_C = 1/(jωC) = −j/(5C). Given Z_C = −j12/5 Ω = −j2.4 Ω, so C = 1/12 F. Z_L1 = jωL1 = j10 Ω, so L1 = 2 H. Z_L2 = jωL2 = j20 Ω, so L2 = 4 H. Vs = 5 sin(5t) = 5 cos(5t − 90°) → Vs = 5∠−90° V. Final answer: Z_R = 8 Ω, Z_C = −j2.4 Ω, Z_L1 = j10 Ω, Z_L2 = j20 Ω, Vs = 5∠−90° V.
